text:
alex: rolled kubeclient 1.4.3 -> 1.4.4 to address CVE-2027-0420. Canary deployed to inference-canary. Need fast post-patch checks: smoke, perf regression, KMS auth, and audit log sanity. Who can run quick validation?

maria: on it. kicking off smoke suite against inference-canary (svc=inference-canary). will run 100 quick requests + latency snapshot p50/p95.

deploy-bot: canary deployment inference-canary: 2/2 updated, 2/2 ready.

maria: smoke results: 95/100 success. 1x 500 on /v1/generate, 4x higher latencies (~+30ms p95). logs: 
```
ERROR inference-handler: grpc: upstream connection reset by peer
stack: runtime.rs:432
```

jamie: saw similar in earlier internal run. suspect keepalive/connection handling changed in kubeclient bump. Not a direct CVE regression but a compatibility quirk. My suggestion: increase canary traffic to 20% for broader sample and run a 10k-token perf run. If errors or p95 >20% persist for 30m, rollback.

alex: also want KMS checks — key wrap/sign flows. last CVE touched pkg layering that might affect auth headers. maria can you run KMS signing test against canary?

maria: running k/encrypt test now. sample run: 
```
$ curl -s -X POST https://inference-canary.internal/v1/sign -d '{"payload":"test"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -i
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{"sig":"..."}

# next request
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{"error":"unauthorized"}
```
Intermittent 401s on second request, looks like short-lived auth header reuse failure.

kelly (oncall): created temporary alert for canary-errors: if 5%+ errors in 10m -> page. runbook: https://redwood.tools/runbooks/postpatch-kubeclient (internal).

jamie: I'll open a dependency follow-up to backport keepalive fix and add an integration test for persistent KMS auth. Proposed rollback criteria: errors >3% OR p95 increase >20% sustained for 30m. I'll also spin up canary dashboard: https://observability.redwood/canary/1977771717

deploy-bot: canary traffic scaled to 20%.

maria: perf run started (10k token workload, 5 concurrent clients). ETA ~12m.

maria: perf complete: throughput -7%, p95 +18% vs baseline; errors 1.2% (no new 5xx after scaling). borderline but not catastrophic. KMS 401 flake still reproducible ~1/50 requests.

alex: holding full rollout. prioritize backport for keepalive/auth fix and add a KMS auth replay test. jamie, assign to eng-runtime and set PR priority high.

jamie: filed CH-1234, PR incoming to bump kubeclient patch + add integration test; tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml for review.

alex: thanks. we'll keep this thread as canonical for the post-patch validation. update here when PR merged or if rollback is needed.

deploy-bot: canary metrics snapshot: errors 1.2%, p95 +18%.
